title: Google's AI Coworker Can Have Its Own Inbox? #shorts
description:
Google unveiled the new Gemini universal agent for work on October 8, 2026, including dedicated coworker identities. This illustrative example shows why human approval matters. Enterprise rollout and permissions vary. Source: Google Cloud Gemini at Work 2026. #Gemini #AIagents #automation #shorts

Official Google announcement: https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/welcome-to-gemini-at-work-2026

Comment: Which action would you keep behind human approval?

captions.text: Google's new AI coworker can have its own identity.
A dedicated role, not just a chatbot reply.
Example: read, draft, and request approval.
Would you give it an inbox?

visual_note: ILLUSTRATIVE RECONSTRUCTION; not product recording; enterprise access and permissions vary.
